title: Claim: Hyflock group says it stole Indonesian passport data from the Directorate General of Immigration; the Director General denies it
date_note: Day the claim circulated on X per kumparanTEKNO (26 November); the article gives no date for any intrusion.
org: Directorate General of Immigration (Ditjen Imigrasi), Indonesia
place: Indonesia (national agency; the article names no city)
geo_basis: country; agency named, Jakarta coordinates used for the national capital
summary: kumparanTEKNO reports that the hacker group Hyflock claims it breached the internal network of Indonesia's Directorate General of Immigration and stole citizens' passport data, including biometric information. The article calls the claim pending verification. Director General Hendarsam Marantoko told kumparanTEKNO on 27 November that the systems are secure and there is no indication of hacking.
plain: A hacker group says it stole Indonesian passport data. The immigration agency's head told the outlet there is no sign of a hack. The claim has not been verified.
exec: Unverified claim of stolen passport data at Indonesia's immigration directorate, denied by its Director General, according to kumparanTEKNO.
impact: Unconfirmed; the agency's Director General denies any breach.

validation.note: Attacker's claim relayed by one publisher (kumparanTEKNO) with the agency head's denial; no independent verification.

report.note: kumparanTEKNO article read through a fetch agent; the number of records is stated inconsistently in the article (tens of millions in the intro, more than 90 million in the body), so no figure is recorded.

review.note: Compared title, claim, denial date 27 Nov, claimed status severity 1, no figure recorded against kumparanTEKNO article
